measure: Census G01 Tot_P_P total persons usual residents; not male+female (ABS perturbation)

methods.bind_SAL: 2021 Census G01 Tot_P_P (usual residents), exact own P10112 SAL code, official same-state name and strict ASGS SAL polygon containment; explicit suburb/locality P31 and row scope; reject own town/LGA classes, parent conflicts, duplicate bindings and points within 0.00003 degree of boundary. More recent values are never overwritten.
methods.bind_UCL: 2021 Census G01 Tot_P_P (usual residents), exact own P10112 UCL code, official same-state name and strict ASGS UCL polygon containment; city/town/village/capital row and explicit own town/city P31; reject parent, LGA/type, duplicate and boundary conflicts. No SUA or GCCSA is used.
methods.keep_newer: Retain exact published 30 June 2025 preliminary LGA ERP at a municipality row with matching literal own LGA code, class, name root, state and point; source Table 1 etc column D.
methods.held: No scalar edit. Reasons are explicit per record. Archived own-item captures retain original dates, fresh successful literal captures supersede them; HTTP failures provide no identity evidence.
methods.identity_continuity: For latest unresolved keys, require unchanged literal v4 name, own QID and state, plus both historical and current points inside the exact own-code target boundary. A changed key receives a reviewed decision_only classification with base/after hashes; no relabel or transfer.
